subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After repairing the four stale assertions, should the token-, registry-, CodeQL-, Blacksmith-, and Codex-bearing action updates land together or be split into smaller security review units?
rationale: The proposed commits have valid official provenance, but they replace executable third-party code operating with sensitive credentials, security permissions, publishing access, and Codex sandbox controls; repository policy leaves acceptance of that combined boundary to owners.

options.title: Keep the grouped update
options.body: Repair all assertions and land the group only after exact-head workflow/security checks and security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, Blacksmith, and Codex action upgrades into narrower independently reviewed PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep the grouped update
recommendation.body: Repair all assertions and land the group only after exact-head workflow/security checks and security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest individual workflow-history owner and is directly involved in this PR, while `openclaw/openclaw-secops` retains required security review.
